title: NSGo game editor checkpoint manifest (version 1)
description: CheckpointManifest is the strict versioned YAML manifest stored at .nsgo/checkpoints/<id>/manifest.yaml.

version.description: Version is the schema version; it must equal CheckpointVersion (1).

id.description: ID is the unique checkpoint directory name (for example "20261126T144100Z-0001").

createdAt.description: CreatedAt is the RFC3339 UTC timestamp when the checkpoint was started.

who.description: Who identifies who initiated the checkpoint ("agent", "you", or "git").

kind.description: Kind identifies why the checkpoint was taken ("turn", "task", or "automation").

title.description: Title is the short human-readable summary shown in the History panel.

detail.description: Detail is optional secondary context (such as change counts or trigger details).

files.description: Files lists every project file captured before its first write in this checkpoint, sorted by path.

CheckpointFile.description: CheckpointFile records one project file captured before its first write in a checkpoint.

path.description: Path is the slash-separated path from the project root (for example "scenes/level_01.scene.yaml").

existed.description: Existed reports whether the file existed before the turn wrote it; false means restoring deletes the file.

size.description: Size is the saved file size in bytes when Existed is true.

sha256.description: SHA256 is the lowercase hex SHA-256 digest of the saved bytes when Existed is true.

mode.description: Mode is the optional 4-digit octal Unix file mode (for example "0755") when non-default.
